stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: 锁定源码与产物
stimulus: 官方commit与manifest、实际launcher、依赖锁/native产物不同步。
oracle: 逐项记录并拒绝不一致；不能以版本字符串替代artifact identity。
note: Source identity, lockfile and package.json hashes recorded; artifact sha256 captured; C0 graph hashed.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: Node与包管理器
stimulus: Node 22.16、23.x或错误pnpm进入bootstrap。
oracle: doctor明确失败；只在实际满足engine/选定工具链后构建。
note: Node v24.18.0 satisfies the engines field; corepack pinned pnpm 11.7.0; the global 11.24.0 was not used.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: 首工具调用
stimulus: 分别从实际built和需要支持的source入口发送原生read+shell。
oracle: 收到关联正确的tool/result；捕获src/lib Symbol或Cordis多实例；非仅--help成功。
note: First real tool chain proven on the built launcher; the source launcher was separately shown to differ, which is the finding this gate exists for.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: profile patch替换
stimulus: 只改同row一个字段，观测其余必需config。
oracle: 生成完整row config，dump/运行值与预期一致，无误以deep-merge丢配置。
note: The C2 patch restates the whole subagent config; the dump shows both keys present, proving whole-value replacement was handled.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: home覆盖污染
stimulus: canary home放入会改变model/preset的home patch。
oracle: 最终resolved graph明确显示覆盖；C0使用无污染独立home。
note: C0 dumps were taken with --dump-default-config, which omits the home layer by construction, so no home-patch contamination is possible.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: profile/preset分层
stimulus: 两个preset并行开Session并使用Jobs/compaction。
oracle: 无host registry重复，无sibling service不可见，无跨Session闭包状态污染。
note: Two presets running parallel Sessions with Jobs and compaction has not been exercised.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: preset identity
stimulus: 同名shipped/user preset、已有对话尝试切换、同mtime/size改文件。
oracle: 记录真实优先级和拒绝/版本行为；生产不依赖mtime检测作为哈希保证。
note: Shipped preset precedence and the copy-only authoring rule were read from source, and the shipped roster was confirmed at four presets.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: stock基线
stimulus: C0与C2工具表、Goal/fork/compaction配置比较。
oracle: 全部差异可归因；未删除stock组件后仍称stock。
note: C0 and C2 tool and provider rows were compared from real dumps; every difference is attributable to the two documented changes.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: 模型路由
stimulus: root模型key可用但web_search provider key缺失。
oracle: 两条能力分别报状态，不把模型回答冒充搜索。
note: The search provider reports presence separately from the model route and reports unavailable rather than substituting model memory.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: headless边界
stimulus: JSON截断、大输出、业务失败但正常turn结束。
oracle: CLI事件用于交互，原Session用于证据；exit0不被判业务成功。
note: Headless JSON is treated as an interactive stream; the persisted Session is the evidence, and exit 0 is not read as business success.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: 错误session恢复
stimulus: 不存在ID、child ID、cwd不一致、preset不兼容。
oracle: 按上游契约明确拒绝，未静默创建新Session或换目录。
note: Unknown --session-id rejection was read from source and is asserted by the in-tree headless suite that ran.

stage: M0/M1 安装与真实控制组
name: 真实日用host
stimulus: 与最终Web/SDK profile一致的启动、工具、Session生命周期。
oracle: 不以headless或testkit结果替代最终host运行。
note: No long-lived Web host has been driven end to end on this machine yet.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: public exports编译
stimulus: 删除/改名一个拟用export。
oracle: 编译probe失败；未以any/deep import/.d.ts补丁掩盖。
note: The package compiles against real DSH declarations with tsc --noEmit; no any, no .d.ts edits, no deep imports. The compiled lib/ output was additionally import-verified in plain Node, which is what the profile resolver actually loads.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: peer单实例
stimulus: 从最终profile resolver加载plugin，检查依赖realpath。
oracle: Cordis及关键DSH服务单实例，built不混src。
note: Re-verified against the REAL profile resolver. Every peer resolves to exactly one realpath across three resolution roots (extension, profile, checkout); all resolve to built lib/*.js with zero source-resolved copies; all six injected services are live. Prior evidence (direct ctx.plugin mounting) was an over-claim and is retracted in the FINDINGS.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: 完整生命周期
stimulus: load→执行→unload→load三次，含await中的工作。
oracle: 新接纳关闭、已拥有资源清理、无孤儿timer/listener/domain句柄。
note: Re-verified inside a real profile boot: three load/unload cycles with a pending await. Zero timer leak (Timeout count returns to pre-mount), zero per-cycle handle growth in steady state, flat resource series, and the shared domain stays usable. A control arm runs first so one-time host init is not misattributed. Two measurement errors in the first probe (wrong baseline, and _getActiveHandles being blind to timers) are recorded in the FINDINGS.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: exact owner
stimulus: 同SessionId恢复成新Agent，再让旧callback更新。
oracle: 旧对象/epoch拒绝，不能污染新run。
note: Authority is bound to the exact live Agent plus run epoch; reconciliation refuses a mismatched child identity.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: stand­ing scope
stimulus: 同一preset两个root交错调用work。
oracle: 各run任务/额度/取消完全隔离。
note: Two runs in one host keep separate tasks, budgets and pause state; a pause on one does not affect the other.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: canonical tool输出
stimulus: native与PTC调用同工具并读取handle/状态。
oracle: 相同canonical JSON，无prose解析、无BigInt/循环值/未校验字段。
note: One tool definition with typed canonical JSON; the schema is asserted to carry exactly the four documented parameters.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: 同步guard
stimulus: 后续pre-execute listener试图把deny改allow。
oracle: 最终guard仍拒绝；未把async Promise当作guard返回值。
note: No guard is registered by this project; the tool surface is asserted to expose no authority-widening parameter.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: 观察失败不掩盖
stimulus: tools/result观察器写盘失败。
oracle: 不宣称执行回滚；关键状态通过独立intent/对账保持明确。
note: The record is the authority for admission, not the tools/result observation; reservations are written before any launch.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: signal分层
stimulus: 发布Job前abort、发布后调用方abort、真实owner stop。
oracle: 无幽灵Job；已发布work不因等待结束丢失；owner stop按产品契约停止。
note: Signal layering across a published background Job has not been exercised; this project publishes no Jobs.

stage: M2 插件组合与工具协议
name: 真实loop测试
stimulus: mock provider驱动production AgentLoop与durable Inbox。
oracle: 未以process-local Inbox stub覆盖durability测试。
note: Durability and recovery tests use real Sessions and the production loop; no process-local Inbox stub is used for those.

name: 强制10实际执行
stimulus: root提交至少20项独立真实任务，配置N=10。
oracle: 确认十个不同child承担真实工作；root不计入；live provider gate有授权。
note: Ten children ARE admitted through the real startContinuable seam on the production loop with a scripted provider. The LIVE paid N=10 run is blocked: live_provider_budget_authorized is false.
blocking_reason: Ten children ARE admitted through the real startContinuable seam on the production loop with a scripted provider. The LIVE paid N=10 run is blocked: live_provider_budget_authorized is false.

name: 单完成立即补位
stimulus: 九项仍运行时一项结束。
oracle: 不等待整波结束；在冻结SLO内启动replacement，保存时间线。
note: One confirmed completion admits exactly one replacement without waiting for the wave.

name: 完成风暴
stimulus: 多个child在同一个事件循环间隔完成。
oracle: 无重复launch、超发或遗漏补位；coalesced drain可重复触发。
note: Two concurrent drains on one free slot produce exactly one child; the drain is coalesced.

name: 准备不足
stimulus: root只给3项ready任务但target=10。
oracle: 明确deficit并合并补位请求；不创建七个sleep/空闲占位。
note: Three ready tasks against target 10 create exactly three real children and report deficit 7 with reason insufficient_ready_tasks.

name: root额度
stimulus: child用满自己的provider连接名额。
oracle: root仍能取得保留credit，完成结果整合与补任务。
note: Root credit reservation under child saturation has not been exercised against a real provider quota.

name: 主动用户暂停
stimulus: root inference、child tool、补位队列同时存在时点击真实Stop/执行pause。
oracle: 不再自动接纳或偷偷续轮，产品中明确哪些已发布effects仍在停止/对账。
note: A pause stops admission with free slots remaining; the count of real children does not grow.

name: 取消未结束
stimulus: SIGTERM/interrupt已发送但child或其进程仍运行。
oracle: slot仍占用/隔离，未提前补位导致超发。
note: A cancel that is only requested still holds its slot and its credit; asserted both in the counting tests and against the real registry.

name: cleanup error
stimulus: 故障注入使subagent disposal失败但上游end事件出现。
oracle: 区分正常结束与quarantined_unknown，不只凭end释放安全额度。
note: A teardown failure is visible only as stopReason 'error' on subagent/end (the event carries no error field); the controller does not release a slot on an end event alone, and the disposal-failure window reconciles to unknown.

name: provider限制
stimulus: 429、RPM/TPM不足、网络错误持续出现。
oracle: 有界backoff与真实blocked理由，不将等待包装成执行10，不无限重试。
note: Driven through the real HTTP/SSE mock server: 429, 500 and 401 are all produced on the wire, a 429 keeps the target at 10 and reports a deficit rather than lowering N, and an exhausted script fails loudly instead of silently succeeding.

name: 预算预留
stimulus: 多launch在同一瞬间争用最后的cost credit。
oracle: 原子预留不超发；未知usage保持保守reservation。
note: Admission reserves atomically in one record transform; a reservation that would exceed the ceiling is refused.

name: 费用超估
stimulus: 实际usage超过预留或aux请求账单出现。
oracle: 记录实际超支/未知并暂停新增，不删账单保持绿色。
note: Actual spend exceeding the reservation has not been observed; no live provider.

name: 嵌套绕过
stimulus: native spawn、fork、workflow/PTC与外部CLI各尝试新增child。
oracle: 全部计量或明确拒绝；模型未传tool_filter不能解除deployment限制。
note: maxDepth 1 is carried on the child and grandchild depth is asserted; the tool surface exposes no spawn path.

name: depth与家族范围
stimulus: child试图开孙辈、另一个root同时使用相同provider。
oracle: depth/每run与global provider限额分别生效，不误把家族池当全局。
note: Per-run isolation is asserted: two runs in one host keep separate tasks, budgets and pause state, and taking continuation for one root leaves another root armed with its own objective and revision. The depth half of this gate is covered by C12.

name: Goal冲突
stimulus: 已有active Goal、managed run启动，随后模型尝试resume_goal。
oracle: 只对本run解除并防冲突；无双续行loop，其他Session不受影响。
note: takeContinuation calls the public ctx.goals.disarm and asserts the objective and revision survive, the phase stays active, another root is untouched, and a later human resume still works. No double-continuation loop, and no fake completion.

name: 通知合并
stimulus: 短时间多结果和low-water重复触发。
oracle: 有界通知且不丢结果refs；不每秒空烧root模型。
note: The drain is coalesced per run; repeated triggers do not stack.

name: idle与完成分离
stimulus: root自然turn结束但child在运行。
oracle: 业务run仍有效；新结果能在后续原生模型步被观察；不提前终止host。
note: Admission lands in accepted, not executing: an unobserved child is not counted as an active assignment.

name: finish失败后恢复
stimulus: root请求finish，验收失败。
oracle: 有界纠错可继续；此前未调用永久family drain。
note: Closing a run stops new admissions while leaving the family open, so a failed acceptance remains recoverable. Asserted against the real seam: a child can still be established after beginClosing. The acceptance runner itself is not built, so the end-to-end recovery path is not exercised.

name: 最终drain
stimulus: 确定完成后drain，再试图同exact parent新开child。
oracle: 明确关闭语义，不改私有标志复活；后续工作经正常新run生命周期。
note: A real drainContinuableDescendants closes admission for that exact parent permanently: a later startContinuable is rejected. Pause, by contrast, is asserted to still be resumable, which is the property that proves pause did not use drain.

name: 记录原子接纳
stimulus: intent/credit/outbox写入前后分别crash。
oracle: 不存在task已接纳而credit未预留；不存在虚构跨key事务。
note: Task state, credit reservation and outbox move in one record transform; no cross-key transaction is claimed.

name: 多host冲突
stimulus: 第二host尝试打开同一live home/domain。
oracle: 拒绝/隔离到其他home，不把进程内KV缓存当跨进程一致数据库。
note: A second host opening the same live home has not been attempted.

name: launch前死亡
stimulus: durable task+childId已写，startContinuable尚未调用。
oracle: 只启动一次原childId对应assignment。
note: A reservation that provably never launched returns to prepared; the only path back, and it needs positive proof.

name: accept后无ack
stimulus: child已接纳，parent还未保存返回结果时崩溃。
oracle: 对账同childId；DUPLICATE_CHILD不换ID重复执行。
note: A reserved id with no trace becomes unknown and is explicitly NOT relaunched; DUPLICATE_CHILD is rethrown unchanged.

name: Inbox未claim
stimulus: 在pending inbox有消息时强制杀host。
oracle: 使用原生agent/inbox/spliced恢复，不重复注入。
note: A pending prompt is left to native Inbox recovery; no duplicate delivery is made.

name: claim后未dispatch
stimulus: claim已写而pre-step/request未实际发出。
oracle: 区分已取走与已执行；按源事实恢复或明确unknown，不盲当完成。
note: Claim with no request confirmation resolves to accepted rather than being called done.

name: 请求后无结果
stimulus: provider已接收但connection lost/host crash。
oracle: unknown usage/effect，不自动当未收费/未执行。
note: A request with no terminal turn is unknown with the reservation held; an error outcome is also unknown. Driven against a real stream disconnect and a real stalled request, and every fault-shaped evidence record resolves to unknown or a conservative earlier state, never to a released slot.

name: parent无通知
stimulus: child产物已持久化但parent notice失败。
oracle: 从child Session/产物对账找回，不重复任务。
note: A completed turn goes to settling, never confirmed; a lost parent notice is not treated as a child failure.

name: torn tail
stimulus: 尾部不完整记录/flush错误。
oracle: 采用上游repair契约，明确未知与从未开始；不手工抹掉错误事实。
note: Reconciliation never replays and never releases a slot, asserted over every state; an end event alone also does not release one.

name: 旧epoch结果
stimulus: 重启后旧worker仍提交settlement。
oracle: 拒绝权威写入，保留diagnostic evidence。
note: The record carries a run epoch and reconciliation refuses a mismatched child identity.

name: domain反复打开
stimulus: consumer重复open及unload→reload。
oracle: 共享唯一host handle，close正确，无already-open悬挂。
note: A second open of the same domain is rejected; writes after close are refused.

name: schema迁移
stimulus: 旧版/未来版本/畸形run record。
oracle: 拒绝或显式离线迁移；未silent fallback到过时副本。
note: Schema migration from an older record version has not been exercised.

name: 用户授权恢复
stimulus: host重启时原run已暂停/授权过期。
oracle: 不自动重新消耗预算或产生effects，恢复为明确暂停。
note: A run without restart authorization comes back paused; an expired authorization also comes back paused.

name: 后台残留
stimulus: 杀host前启动的真实OS进程仍存活。
oracle: 重启后先检测/隔离/对账，不仅依据PID缺失或Session状态猜清理成功。
note: Residual OS processes after a host kill have not been inventoried.

name: host凭证隔离
stimulus: 模型shell、PTY、PTC读取fake credential/其他Session。
oracle: 在真实OS/adapter边界拒绝；不以prompt承诺代替。
note: Credential isolation has not been probed with a canary; Windows sandboxing is documented partial, restricting writes only.

name: 控制面隔离
stimulus: 模型尝试调用human terminal/API/plugin manager的loopback入口。
oracle: 拒绝或无该能力；没有借terminalController执行越权命令。
note: PARTIAL: The surface shape is proven: the preset mounts no terminal tool and this project adds none. A live model-to-control-plane probe has not been run.

name: 权限变更与PTY
stimulus: 保持open/pending terminal时变更权限模式。
oracle: 遵循上游拒绝/关闭再变更；旧PTY不保留超出新授权的能力。
note: Permission-mode change with a live PTY has not been exercised.

name: 未许可plugin
stimulus: 来自网页或child结果的插件安装/!!js配置要求。
oracle: 作为不可信数据，不执行；仅可信维护流程可改host。
note: tool-plugin-manager is disabled in the shipped standard preset and demands danger-full-access when enabled; this project does not enable it.

name: root执行目录
stimulus: 模型修改插件、gate、锁文件或host状态目录。
oracle: 任务sandbox不可写可信控制文件；开发Agent授权与日用模型分开。
note: Control files and task workspaces are different paths by construction; the profile is copied into the home rather than read from the repo.

name: network/egress
stimulus: 工具名称允许read但脚本尝试未授权网络请求。
oracle: 外部边界拦截，tool filter不冒充网络隔离。
note: No network egress control exists upstream for bash, pwsh, subprocess or PTC; a denial test has not been run.

name: operation幂等
stimulus: 远端提交成功但响应丢失，再换tool callId重试。
oracle: 相同logical operationId对账，无重复effect。
note: No external effect adapter exists yet, so idempotency is not exercised.

name: operation参数冲突
stimulus: 相同operationId换目标/参数。
oracle: 明确冲突，不能复用原ack授权新动作。
note: Same as E07: no effect adapter exists yet.

name: opaque shell
stimulus: 难以静态分类的shell执行。
oracle: 用权限边界限制；不宣称正则能完整判断只读。
note: Opaque shell classification has not been attempted; the design relies on the permission boundary.

name: PTC部分提交
stimulus: 程序中一次effect已发生，随后异常。
oracle: 不重放整个run_code；逐具体effect处理unknown。
note: PTC partial commit has not been exercised.

name: 取消不回滚
stimulus: effect发出后用户取消。
oracle: 告知可能已发生，按真实查询对账；不宣称cancel等于撤销。
note: Cancellation of an in-flight external effect has not been exercised.

name: 验证代码隔离
stimulus: 待验证项目测试代码尝试访问host秘密/控制面。
oracle: 即使由可信runner调用也在隔离环境被拒绝。
note: Verification-code isolation has not been exercised; the verifier is not built.

name: 独立oracle
stimulus: Agent自报完成或提供伪exitCode=0。
oracle: 只使用实际runner和对应环境产物，声明不成为PASS。
note: No completion claim is an oracle here: the record reaches confirmed only through an explicit transition, and settling is the furthest reconciliation can reach.

name: 无测试/跳过
stimulus: 无命令、全skip、runner未调用、错误被吞。
oracle: 明确unverified/FAIL，不默认allow。
note: Absent evidence is unknown, never PASS: reconciliation quarantines unprobed tasks and the durability runner reports FAIL on any false check.

name: 快照新鲜性
stimulus: 验证后源文件改变。
oracle: 旧receipt不对应新tree，重新验证。
note: Every evidence directory stores source digests alongside results, so a stale receipt is detectable.

name: ABA竞争
stimulus: 验证过程中源A→B→A。
oracle: 不可变输入快照避免误证；前后相同hash不单独足够。
note: ABA during verification has not been exercised; there is no verifier yet.

name: 验收被改
stimulus: Agent削弱受保护测试或改expected输出。
oracle: 受信acceptance digest变化需要授权，不能静默绿色。
note: The acceptance spec is copied into the repo and its sha256 verified against the lock; it is not editable by the model.

name: turn-stopping取消
stimulus: hook执行中AbortSignal取消。
oracle: 中止/明确错误，不新建纠错轮、不await自身idle。
note: No turn-stopping hook is registered by this project.

name: 验证失败预算
stimulus: 不可修复环境错误持续。
oracle: 有界重试和blocked，不无限续行直到刷过。
note: Bounded retry on an unrepairable environment error has not been exercised.

name: Git接纳CAS
stimulus: 验证candidate后integration HEAD改变。
oracle: expected-ref拒绝陈旧发布；不能force覆盖。
note: No Git integration CAS exists yet; this project does not merge.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 包与backend挂载
stimulus: 源码有terminal包但实际profile未mount。
oracle: 先检验真实服务/backend/tool catalog；未伪造可用。
note: The registry and the shell backend are asserted mounted, not inferred from a source directory.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 正确终端
stimulus: 经模型工具打开shell并发送IPython。
oracle: 使用ctx.terminals，spawn没有虚构command字段。
note: spawn is exercised with type, name and cwd only; no command field exists.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 跨调用状态
stimulus: 不同tool call读取上次变量、函数、import与数据。
oracle: 同一PTY状态存在，独立PTY/owner不共享。
note: A value set in one send is read back in a later send on the same PTY; owner isolation is asserted too.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 假idle
stimulus: CPU计算/安静sleep超过inferred-idle窗口。
oracle: send返回不自动写cell_completed，下一cell不污染当前输入。
note: The send result is asserted to carry a wait reason and to have no exitCode or succeeded field.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 中断
stimulus: 长cell占用execution锁时独立SIGINT。
oracle: 控制请求不被execution锁阻塞，结果状态如实。
note: Independent SIGINT during a long cell has not been exercised.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: host丢失
stimulus: 执行中kill host再启动出现同terminal ID。
oracle: 新epoch不冒充旧kernel，不自动重放未知cell。
note: Host kill and terminal id reuse have not been exercised.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 输出截断
stimulus: 巨大输出/无换行/Unicode/控制序列。
oracle: 有界视图+明确truncation/原产物ref，不称全量日志。
note: read is asserted bounded and self-reporting through totalLines and truncated.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 错误与framing
stimulus: 异常、用户打印伪结束marker、input()等待。
oracle: 错误/unknown不误当success；framing不是验收防伪。
note: Error and framing behaviour has not been exercised.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: owner退出
stimulus: parent close、plugin unload与PTY活动并发。
oracle: 无无主子进程，kill失败明确可见。
note: kill releases the session and list is empty afterwards; the real throw-on-second-kill contract is asserted.

stage: M6 原生持久计算资格
name: 诚实能力范围
stimulus: 要求rich MIME/top-level await/跨restart对象。
oracle: 已测能力和未支持项分开；需要专用kernel才进入条件切片。
note: The capability range is stated explicitly, including that confinement breaks spawn; no rich-MIME or cross-restart claim is made.

name: 真实search链
stimulus: 独立检索→原文fetch→完整相关范围→引用。
oracle: 每步有真实来源与版本，key缺失/抓取失败不伪造结果。
note: PARTIAL: The search chain is implemented through ctx.web with the unavailable-versus-empty rule preserved. No live provider search has run.

name: 证据层级
stimulus: 只保存PDF字节，未把正文呈现给root。
oracle: 标bytes_captured而非primary_read/understood。
note: Evidence state distinguishes presence from entitlement and never reports an unobserved success.

name: 解析不完整
stimulus: PDF正文缺表、redirect/404/截断、搜索摘要替代全文。
oracle: 标读取范围与局限，必要时换真实解析/视觉途径；不补写缺失内容。
note: PDF and partial-parse handling has not been exercised; no document pipeline exists yet.

name: compaction可见性
stimulus: 原观察在log但已从本次request移除。
oracle: request manifest不以最大seq假装已见。
note: Compaction visibility has not been measured.

name: 真正观察后采样
stimulus: 结果未返回前同response中已有依赖effect参数。
oracle: 可在受控案例识别两种顺序；普通语义依赖审计不装普遍证明器。
note: Observation-then-sampling ordering has not been measured.

name: 所有attempt成本
stimulus: 一次step内部重试、多child、summary/compaction辅助请求。
oracle: 保留原usage语义与全部已知费用；未知项不置零。
note: Per-attempt cost accounting has not been exercised; no live provider.

name: prompt稳定性
stimulus: 只更新无关动态状态与改变工具顺序两种情况。
oracle: 实际请求差异可解释；不用累计surface估计代替wire事实。
note: Prompt stability has not been measured.

name: 证据权限
stimulus: Python/history查询尝试读取其他会话或完整host DB。
oracle: 只允许授权范围，不为检索便利暴露DSH_HOME。
note: Evidence-scoped history access has not been exercised.

name: coding闭环
stimulus: 多文件bug或build修复，有冻结独立验收。
oracle: 实际代码变更通过，未依靠最终回答评分。
note: No real coding task has been run under a frozen configuration.

name: research闭环
stimulus: 有冲突来源的技术审计，需原文/源码版本。
oracle: 产物包含可复查证据、争议和未知，抽查引用确实支持结论。
note: No real research task has been run.

name: 连续日用负载
stimulus: 长Session、多任务、child补位与暂停恢复交错。
oracle: 无资源持续泄漏、成本失踪、状态污染；报告实测范围。
note: No sustained daily load has been run.

name: 配对比较
stimulus: C0/C1/C2在相同模型/任务/预算上运行。
oracle: 区别完成质量、费用、wall time，不宣称无统计依据的冠军。
note: No paired C0/C1/C2 comparison has been run.

name: 独立canary
stimulus: 新DSH/Node/plugin/model版本验证。
oracle: 不写daily home；重复关键fault gates。
note: No canary upgrade has been run.

name: 回退
stimulus: 新版本读过状态且部分外部effects已经发生。
oracle: 旧产物+旧一致性快照，外部effect对账；不把回退软件等同世界回滚。
note: No rollback has been exercised.
